evidence.description: Why the plugin thinks so — the same shape the built-in catalogue emits, so a surface renders one evidence type and not two. `grade` is ADR-004's: `observed` quotes the lines, `inferred` derived the claim, `asserted` is the repository's own statement, `absent` is a stated absence.

detail.description: What is there, quoted or stated, bounded by the detector.

locator.description: A resolvable pointer: `src/parser.rs:240-262`, a path, an episode id.

jump.description: Where the surface opens when the reviewer accepts the finding. A view this build has no such name for is replaced with the episode and said out loud (rule R7) rather than guessed at.

target.description: What to open in it: `<episode>` or `<episode>#<path-or-region>`.

description: One finding raised by a detector written outside this repository (`e6.7`). The four parts every finding in this product carries — a sentence, a jump, a confidence, one key that mutes it — plus the version and the namespace that make a third-party claim safe to print beside a built-in's. Unknown fields are ignored on read; a finding whose `schema_version` this build cannot read, whose `finding_type` its plugin did not declare, or whose message or subject is empty is ignored with a notice naming it, and the run continues. The rules and the numbers they move are in `fathom_analyze::plugin::finding`.

confidence.description: `0..=1`. A value outside the range is clamped and said (rule R5), and `1.0` on a claim whose evidence is every piece `inferred` is reduced to `0.95` — the price the built-in catalogue pays for the same claim.

episode_id.description: The episode the finding is about.

evidence.description: Why the plugin thinks so. A `high` with an empty list here is demoted to `medium` and the notice says so (rule R4).

finding_type.description: `namespace.id`. A plugin may only raise types inside its own namespace and only ones it declared at registration (rule R2); the bare, dotless spelling belongs to the built-in catalogue, so a plugin cannot take a built-in's suppression family.

message.description: The claim, in one sentence a person wrote. Empty is not a finding (rule R3).

plugin.description: The plugin that raised it, as it named itself.

plugin_version.description: The plugin's own version, so a re-run after the plugin changed is distinguishable from the last one.

schema_version.description: The version of this shape the finding was written against. A number greater than the reader's is a refusal, not a partial read.

severity.description: ADR-004 Appendix A's `finding.severity` CHECK, and the only severity vocabulary in the product with a constraint behind it. There is no fourth word.

subject.description: What within the episode: a path, a symbol, a test name. Empty is not a finding (rule R3).

suppression_key.description: The one key that silences this finding: `<type>` or `<type>:<subject>`. A key outside the plugin's own namespace is rewritten (rule R6) — a plugin may mute its own findings and nothing else.

title: Fathom plugin finding

x-fathom.compatibility: additive changes keep the version; breaking changes bump it; an unreadable version is ignored with a notice
